script: Neptune was found with math before anyone saw it. Astronomers noticed Uranus was being tugged by something unseen. Urbain Le Verrier calculated where the mystery planet should be. In 1846, astronomers looked there and found Neptune almost exactly in place. It is the only planet that cannot be seen without a telescope.
